skill.remushoku.sg_style.desc: Fast-paced style focused on offence. Required for the rest of the tree.
skill.remushoku.arm_chop.desc: Powerful strike to the arm of the enemy in front: high damage, weakness and it drops what it is holding.
skill.remushoku.quick_strikes.desc: Five rapid strikes on the enemy in front of you.
skill.remushoku.longsword_silence.desc: Dash 8 blocks forward faster than sound, cutting everything in your path.
skill.remushoku.longsword_light.desc: Dash 16 blocks faster than light with a devastating cut.
skill.remushoku.light_reversal.desc: Passive: 25% chance to block a melee attack and counter by cutting the enemy's hands (double damage, weakness and it drops its weapon).
skill.remushoku.wg_style.desc: Slower style focused on defence. Required for the rest of the tree.
skill.remushoku.deflect.desc: Toggle: deflect incoming attacks (5 mana, once every 3 seconds). Requires a sword in hand.
skill.remushoku.steadfast.desc: Removes all negative effects, fire and freezing.
skill.remushoku.magic_block.desc: Passive: take half damage from magic.
skill.remushoku.true_observation.desc: Every living thing within 32 blocks glows for 10 seconds.
skill.remushoku.flow.desc: For 10 seconds, the next hit you take is blocked and reflected back stronger.
skill.remushoku.aura_repulsion.desc: For 10 seconds nobody can get within 5 blocks of you.
skill.remushoku.aura_motion.desc: Strongly knocks back and damages everything within 8 blocks.
skill.remushoku.deprivation_kingdom.desc: For 15 seconds you create a 4-block circle: every enemy that enters gets struck.
skill.remushoku.ng_style.desc: Adaptability style: use any means to win. Required for the rest of the tree.
skill.remushoku.ng_magic.desc: Passive: cast spells up to Intermediate level with the same keys as a mage.
skill.remushoku.ng_items.desc: Passive: learn to use special items in combat (Adhesive Bomb).
skill.remushoku.duel_wielding.desc: Toggle: with a weapon in your off hand, you also strike with it when attacking.
skill.remushoku.sword_throw.desc: Throw a slash of your sword at range (double weapon damage). You keep the sword.
skill.remushoku.touki_manipulation.desc: Reshape your Touki into armor: absorption and resistance for 30 seconds.
skill.remushoku.arsenal_mastery.desc: Toggle: use your skills with axes, pickaxes and other tools, not just swords.
skill.remushoku.touki_amplification.desc: With Touki active, amplify it: strength II, speed II and regeneration for 20 seconds.

guide.remushoku.port_books: In this version: hold the magic stone in one hand and right-click with the elemental book in the other to learn that level. The Spell Book shows every arrow combination.
guide.remushoku.circles_1: Draw a magic circle with chalk: right-click while looking at the ground. Form a spell with the arrows without casting it and right-click the circle with an empty hand to inscribe it. Sneak with an empty hand to erase it.
guide.remushoku.circles_2: With a stone of the same level as the spell: right-click turns it into a trap that fires when stepped on; sneaking imbues the stone so you can use it in a staff. Paper or a blank scroll makes spell scrolls. Four matching stones on an empty circle upgrade to the next level.
guide.remushoku.guild_1: The Adventurer's Guild is found in cities. Accept jobs at the job board or from the receptionist: kill monsters, hand in items or build golems. Complete jobs to earn rank XP and coins, and climb from rank F up to S. Spend your coins at the blacksmith, general store and magic vendor.
